ns2:course.label: Prof Practice Seminar I
ns2:course.description: The goal is to start the process of integrating all the foundation knowledge of generalist social work that students have learned and begin applying it to real life situations. Students will complete a portfolio and a service learning experience that will help them being to make the connection between the 10 core competencies, theories and applications to real life experiences. During this course students will begin the process of being matched with the agency where they will serve their internship during the last semester of their senior year. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: SOCW 401.
